question: Related Questions Q. Take a loan to purchase a house 2626 views Q. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 27351 Country: India Title: Presently i am repaying a personal loan of Rs 5 lac. Total amount including interest is 6.5 lacs.Current outstanding Loan amount is 1.5 lacs and as per the loan statement from bank it consists of 25k interest & 1.25L principal.It means I have already paid 1.25L interest till date. I just received a refund from my Employee PF account of Rs 3.25 lacs out of which 1.25 lacs is interest earned. Could i use this interest amount(1.25L) earned to prepay entire 1.5L and close my loan? Question: Assalamalekum, Presently i am repaying a personal loan of Rs 5 lac. Total amount including interest is 6.5 lacs.Current outstanding Loan amount is 1.5 lacs and as per the loan statement from bank it consists of 25k interest & 1.25L principal.It means I have already paid 1.25L interest till date. I just received a refund from my Employee PF account of Rs 3.25 lacs out of which 1.25 lacs is interest earned. Could i use this interest amount(1.25L) earned to prepay entire 1.5L and close my loan? Answer ID: 27351 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1786/506/TL=1431) (Fatwa: 1786/506/TL=1431) In this case, you can use the interest amount to pay off the remaining loan of 1.5 lac. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
